description: Read an existing n8n workflow JSON (a template from n8n.io, an export, anything) and say what it would do before it runs: every node's label (read-only / reversible / irreversible, computed from the node's own resource + operation), which irreversible steps (send, post, delete, pay) would run with nobody asked, which steps already have an approval in front of them, and which nodes have no account connected. With add_gates=true it returns a copy of the workflow with a one-tap Approve / Decline step (Slack, Telegram, Gmail…) wired in front of every such step. Nothing is run; the original is not modified.

add_gates.description: Also return `gated_workflow`: a copy that asks before every irreversible step.

ask_via.description: Where the Approve / Decline message goes.

workflow.description: The n8n workflow JSON (nodes + connections), as exported or as a template's JSON.

name: inspect_workflow

gated_workflow.description: only with add_gates: the workflow with Approve/Decline gates added

nodes.description: every node: app, label, why, gated, has_account

risky.description: irreversible nodes with no approval in front

verdict.description: one line: what would run without asking

title: Check an existing n8n workflow before running it
